facts.fact: T-TEL states that senior high schools upload student records to the WAEC Student Transcript Portal, linked to the Ministry of Education's Secondary Education Institutions dashboard, which covers over 720 secondary schools and almost 1.5 million learners; the system went live in 2024 and the document describes no such system in basic schools beyond naming the mSRC.
facts.system: WAEC Student Transcript Portal (linked to the SEI Dashboard)

facts.fact: T-TEL states that secondary schools upload learners' academic records to the Student Transcript Portal, over 60 million records since it went live in 2024 at a 97.2% national average completion rate, with completion reviewed monthly by regional and national oversight committees; the document does not state how often a school uploads.
